items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: play what I thought I heard on these records by Louie Jordan and Nat King Cole

ctx.x: Uh, I was twelve, thirteen, fourteen maybe. Maybe twelve, you know. Pretty young, but totally impressionable because I'd been trying to play since I was five, you know. There was a room in my home, in our home that uh, in winter time, they didn't turn on the heat unless we had guests, you know, so I would put on my overcoat and go in there and tinkle and play what I thought I heard on these records by Louie Jordan and Nat King Cole. And now I know I wasn't

even close, but at that time I thought I was. So … [laughs] it was like fooling myself in a way, you know? But in a good way. You know, just picking out things and making up stuff as my mother used to refer to it, but …
